digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI, reconciler engine, legacy compatibility adapters
propositions: Make `rebar bridge preview` and `rebar bridge sync` the primary CLI vocabulary while preserving `rebar reconcile` as a compatibility adapter with unchanged defaults and behavior.

Argument-less `rebar reconcile` remains dry-run by default; argument-less `python -m rebar_reconciler` and `bridge sync` remain live; legacy `--mode` and `--filter-local-ids` retain their documented semantics.
Canonical `--only`/`--except` filters narrow differ inputs before execution; legacy `--filter-local-ids` continues filtering writes after full examination.
Normalized request parsing in `request.py` unifies both canonical and legacy entrypoints into a shared core execution path before lock acquisition.
Unresolvable or stale `--only`/`--except` tokens and selection targets that disappear between preflight and lock exit with code 2, named IDs, and no lock/differ/apply/persist.

Explicit `--max-changes` cap produces deterministic capped-live manifests with applied/deferred lists; uncapped live and legacy bootstrap behavior remain unchanged; invalid/zero/negative caps exit 2 before lock.
